findings.detail: Blank-issuer industry subtotal rows are interleaved with genuine positions and inflate the extracted position sum above the filing total.

rationale: Class 3 anchor triangulation is decisive. The extracted position sum is 544,170,799, while the filing schedule reports total debt and equity investments at fair value of 224,956,333 (table 8 row 16); the filing's fair-value hierarchy independently reports Level 3 investments of 224,956 thousand (table 21 row 5). The schedule contains repeated blank-issuer industry subtotal rows among position rows, including table 5 rows 7 and 10, establishing subtotal leakage as the extraction mechanism. Cash equivalents are separately reported and do not explain the 319,214,466 excess.
